title: Deliver audio-only playback support to Opencast 21
problem: Opencast 21 locks paella-opencast-core 2.0.1, which drops audio/m4a delivery tracks and produces an empty Paella streams array even though support was released in 2.0.3.
reproduce: Convert the issue's single presentation/delivery audio/m4a track with the package versions pinned by Opencast develop; EventConversor.getStreams returns an empty array.
acceptance: The same Opencast search result produces one presentation stream with role mainAudio and an audio source, the focused regression passes, and the complete engage-paella-player-8 bundle builds.
repair: Advance only the required Paella core, Opencast core and skin lock entries to the minimum compatible releases that contain audio-only conversion, and add an integration regression using the reported payload shape.

verification.limitations: BCL executes the exact issue payload against the locked dependency before and after the repair and builds both Paella bundles. It does not ingest media into a complete Opencast server or exercise browser audio output.
verification.ownerCheck: Install the resulting Opencast 21 build, load the audio-only event from issue #984, and confirm playback starts with audio controls and no empty streams manifest error.

publish.commitMessage: Fix audio-only playback in Paella Player 8
